findings: main.rs accepts only --input pdhid and NativeHid::open opens both /dev/usb_hid_kbd and /dev/usb_hid_mouse. Either open failure returns before a seat exists. drain reads both fds.
enable_pdhid_seat always calls add_keyboard and add_pointer. Smithay compute_caps advertises Pointer only when the pointer handle is Some, so a keyboard-only seat is add_keyboard alone.

PDHIDPushKeyboardEvent publishes /dev/usb_hid_kbd on first use when gKbdLock is missing (PDHIDEventQueue.cpp:544). The mouse node is published from pd_hid_mouse_enqueue (line 570), not with the keyboard. A keyboard-only driver therefore does not create the mouse node.
pd_hid_kbd_open sets gKbdGrabbed until the last close. The mouse open path does not. A later compositor open of the keyboard node takes console delivery for as long as that fd lives.

PDM1SPIHID::poll calls handleReport only for m1kbd_keyboard_input (device 1, flags 0x20, command 0x10). Other reports increment otherMessages and are not relabeled as keyboard or trackpad. This file does not call PDHIDPushMouseEvent. IOHIDEventService pushes keyboard-page usages <= 0xE7 into PDHIDPushKeyboardEvent. Astra's response-id fix is separate and was not reviewed here.

host_progress appends pdm1kbd=1 only when keyboard_enabled is true. keyboard_enabled requires the exact keyboard_experiment record, a ramdisk, fileset kind 12, exactly one org.puredarwin.driver.PDM1SPIHID member, and not desktop_enabled. ConsoleSession rejects desktop and keyboard together and sends darwin-keyboard-test only for the keyboard flag. desktop_experiment alone does not append the bootarg.

later_wm_darwin.keep: --input pdhid still means both character devices
later_wm_darwin.add: --input pdhid-kbd opens only /dev/usb_hid_kbd with the existing O_NONBLOCK|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC and character-device check, drains that queue only, and does not open /dev/usb_hid_mouse
later_wm_darwin.seat: add_keyboard always for this token. Call add_pointer only when a mouse fd was opened. deliver_hid rejects pointer events when no pointer was added. Missing keyboard node is a hard error. Missing mouse node is not an error on pdhid-kbd.
later_wm_darwin.not_success: A created seat, an advertised capability, or a later queue read is not native input. The existing stderr line that qualification is still required stays.

accept_when: ramdisk is present in the bound contents
kernel filetype is 12 and exactly one fileset member is named org.puredarwin.driver.PDM1SPIHID
later_host_record.reject: any other object, a non-int version, keyboard_experiment present, desktop_experiment absent, missing ramdisk, or a member count other than 1
later_host_record.effect: Append the single token pdm1kbd=1 to the existing BOOTARGS. Leave ConsoleSession keyboard false. Do not send /usr/bin/darwin-keyboard-test. The desktop command string stays /usr/bin/darwin-desktop-test plus the validated nonce.
tests_to_add: desktop record plus this exact object appends pdm1kbd=1 and does not write keyboard-input.bin
this object without desktop_experiment is refused
this object plus keyboard_experiment is refused
a second or missing PDM1SPIHID member is refused

limits: Source reading only. No compositor edit, no host_progress edit, no build, no boot. Node publication and a seat capability do not show that a key arrived or that a person typed.
